The Dugout Canoe is the river boat, hollowed from one log for rivers only, so its card has no outrigger. The outrigger is Far Territory's separate Outrigger Canoe card (FT_Outrigger), used for the sea crossing. If you want the river canoe to get an outrigger too, mark it again and say so; that is a card text change as well as art.
